# Generated — do not edit

This `funke/demo` package is a **generated copy** of `src/funke/demo/` (the pure-Python,
Spark-free ADT engine). Databricks Apps install dependencies from `requirements.txt` and cannot
reference the project wheel by a relative or per-target path, so the engine is vendored here and
synced with the app source.

Regenerate it with `just build-app` (or `just vendor-engine`) after changing anything under
`src/funke/demo/`. The single source of truth is `src/funke/demo/` — edit there, never here.
